units.source_text: 我几乎知悉有关父亲的一切，倘若离开父亲，只会怀念父子之情。

en.t: I knew almost everything about my father, and if I were to leave him, I would only miss the bond between father and son.

units.source_text: 而先生的大部分经历，我还不了解，而且，始终没有机会倾听他答应告诉我的他自己的过去。

en.t: But I still did not understand most of Sensei's experiences, and I had never had the chance to hear the story of his own past that he had promised to tell me.

units.source_text: 总之，先生在我看来是模糊不清的。

en.t: In short, Sensei remained indistinct to me.

units.source_text: 然而，不穿越这混沌，抵达光明之所，我便心有不甘。

en.t: Yet unless I passed through this confusion and reached a place of light, I could not be satisfied.

units.source_text: 同先生断了联系，对我而言是莫大的痛苦。

en.t: To lose contact with Sensei was a tremendous pain for me.

units.source_text: 我请母亲看了日子，确定了去东京的日期。

en.t: I asked my mother to choose an auspicious day and settled on the date for going to Tokyo.
